verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of filtering installs or task runs to a subset of workspace packages, and nothing about selecting only packages affected by a change. One community comment mentions "mise's monorepo tasks" without describing any filtering or affected-detection behavior. The `-C/--cd` flag only runs mise in a single directory, which is an adjacent control, not workspace filtering.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run installs and scripts filtered to a subset of workspace packages (including only those affected by a change)
